title: N -W F P Public Service Commission Amendment Act 2003

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Public Service Commission Amendment Act 2003
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XIV OF 2003
ACT XIV OF 2003
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE PUBLIC
SERVICE COMMISSION
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2003.
An Act further to
amend the North-West Frontier
Province Public
Service Commission Ordinance, 1978.
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary
7th January, 2004]
No.PA./N.-W.F.P./Legis:1/2004/814,
dated 7-1-2004.--The North-West Frontier Province Public Service Commission
(Amendment) Bill, 2003 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of
North-West Frontier Province on the 19th December, 2003 and assented to by the
Governor of the North-West Frontier Province on 26th December, 2003
is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of the North West
Frontier Province.
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and
commencement.-------(1) This Act may be called the North-West Frontier
Province Public Service Commission (Amendment) Act, 2003.
(2) It shall come into force at
once

7th January, 2004]
No.PA./N.-W.F.P./Legis:1/2004/814,
dated 7-1-2004.--The North-West Frontier Province Public Service Commission
(Amendment) Bill, 2003 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of
North-West Frontier Province on the 19th December, 2003 and assented to by the
Governor of the North-West Frontier Province on 26th December, 2003
is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of the North West
Frontier Province.
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
2. Amendment of section 7 of
N.-W.F.P. Ordinance No.XI of 1978.---In. the North-West Frontier Province
Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1978 (N.-W.F.P. Ordinance No.XI of 1978),
in section 7, in subsection (2), for clause (i), the following shall be
substituted, namely:
"(i) posts pertaining to
house hold staff in the Governor House and the Chief Minister House;".
